summary: Final adversarial execution review for WI-556 (Final-SHA mandatory-skill coverage with terminating receipts). The implementation is verified to correctly enforce final-SHA coverage verification in check-chain-receipts.mjs, atomic merge finalization in merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs, deterministic compilation/verification in scripts/lib/skill-coverage.mjs, and schema validation. A minor display formatting issue was identified on the passing path of --coverage mode where result.coverage_rows retains the array of result objects rather than flattened task rows.

findings.claim: --coverage mode table rendering prints undefined columns for passing target SHAs due to unflattened coverage_rows
findings.analysis: In check-chain-receipts.mjs, checkShaAgainstReceipts collects verifyCoverage result objects into coverageResults ([{ verdict, reasons, rows }]) and invokes options.coverageReport(coverageResults). In checkSha, the callback captures this array and sets result.coverage_rows = capturedCoverageRows.flat(). Because capturedCoverageRows is a 1D array of result objects, .flat() returns the array of result objects instead of extracting and flattening the inner result.rows arrays. In main(), renderCoverageTable expects rows to be individual task rows ({ task_id, skill, status, result, detail }), causing table rendering on the passing path to print undefined for each column. The failure path (when result.verdict !== 'pass') returns result.rows directly and renders correctly.
findings.proposed_fix: In scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs checkSha, update the options.coverageReport callback to extract and flatten the row arrays: options.coverageReport = (res) => { capturedCoverageRows = res.flatMap((r) => r.rows || []); };
